g.title: G

Wait for the leader window. Meaning: This validator is the scheduled leader and waits for a usable way to start its window. Purpose: It can start with a ready parent or use the gated early-start path.

Early work on an expected parent. Meaning: The leader starts its first block on the preceding window’s last block before ParentReady confirms the parent. Purpose: This saves time if the expected parent becomes ready. The feature and migration gates must permit this path.
g.text: Start early on expected parent P
Send slices of the first block

g.title: H01: Start on expected parent. When: The preceding window’s last block is available. The feature and migration gates permit the early-start path. Action: Start the first block on expected parent P. Reason: The leader can save certificate-wait time when P later becomes the ready parent.

a.xlink:title: The leader can save certificate-wait time when P later becomes the ready parent.
H01: Start on expected\nparent

g.title: Complete the first block. Meaning: The first block now uses a ready parent. The leader produces the remaining block content. Purpose: The parent uncertainty is resolved, so normal first-block production can finish.
g.text: Produce the rest of the first block

g.title: H02: Ready parent already known. When: ParentReady is available before the leader starts early work. Action: Build directly on the ready parent. Reason: The required parent evidence already exists.

a.xlink:title: The required parent evidence already exists.
H02: Ready parent already\nknown

g.title: Stop work for a passed window. Meaning: Agave has determined that the production window is no longer current. Purpose: Stopping prevents more work on a window that the network has passed.

H12: Window already passed. When: Agave finds that the requested production window is already unnecessary. Action: Do not start that window. Reason: New production for a passed window cannot supply the work that the current window needs.

a.xlink:title: New production for a passed window cannot supply the work that the current window needs.
H12: Window already passed

g.title: H03: No ready parent yet. When: The leader still has no ParentReady notification. Action: Continue early slice production. Reason: The work can be kept if the expected parent later becomes ready.

a.xlink:title: The work can be kept if the expected parent later becomes ready.
H03: No ready parent yet

g.title: Compare the two parents. Meaning: The leader compares the ready parent Q with the expected parent P, including the block identity. Purpose: The result determines whether existing execution work remains usable.

H04: Ready parent arrives. When: The leader receives the selected ready parent Q. Action: Compare the full identity of Q with P. Reason: A slot number alone does not identify a block. The leader must know whether its execution parent is correct.

a.xlink:title: A slot number alone does not identify a block. The leader must know whether its execution parent is correct.
H04: Ready parent arrives

g.title: H13: Network moved on. When: Agave receives WindowMovedOn during early production. Action: Stop the unnecessary work. Reason: The leader must stop spending production time on a window that the network has passed.

a.xlink:title: The leader must stop spending production time on a window that the network has passed.
H13: Network moved on

g.title: Happy handover. Meaning: The ready parent and the expected parent are the same block. Purpose: The leader keeps its early work because it already used a permitted parent.
H05: Same parent. When: Q and P identify the same block. Action: Keep the existing first-block work. Reason: The work already uses a permitted parent.

a.xlink:title: The work already uses a permitted parent.
H05: Same parent

g.title: Sad handover. Meaning: The ready parent differs from the expected parent. The leader changes parent and resets the first block’s execution work. Purpose: The completed block must extend a permitted parent. The paper permits this change once in the first slot of the window.

H06: Different parent. When: Q and P identify different blocks. Action: Change the parent to Q and reset the first-block execution work. Reason: The leader must build on a parent that meets ParentReady, even when its earlier expectation was wrong.

a.xlink:title: The leader must build on a parent that meets ParentReady, even when its earlier expectation was wrong.
H06: Different parent

g.title: H07: Continue on P. When: The existing parent has the required ready-parent evidence. Action: Produce the rest of the first block. Reason: The leader can now complete normal production without a parent reset.

a.xlink:title: The leader can now complete normal production without a parent reset.
H07: Continue on P

g.title: H08: Continue on Q. When: The leader has changed to the permitted parent Q. Action: Produce the first block from the new parent state. Reason: The final block must describe execution on Q, not on the discarded parent state.

a.xlink:title: The final block must describe execution on Q, not on the discarded parent state.
H08: Continue on Q

g.title: Produce the next block. Meaning: Each later block in this window uses the preceding block as its parent. Purpose: These links keep the leader’s blocks on a connected chain.
g.text: Use the preceding block as parent

g.title: H09: First block complete. When: The first block is complete and another slot remains. Action: Use that block as the next block’s parent. Reason: The next block must continue the same leader-window chain.

a.xlink:title: The next block must continue the same leader-window chain.
H09: First block complete

g.title: H10: More window slots. When: The current block is complete and another slot remains in the window. Action: Produce the next block on the current block. Reason: Successive parent links keep the produced blocks connected.

a.xlink:title: Successive parent links keep the produced blocks connected.
H10: More window slots

g.title: Leader window complete. Meaning: The leader has completed the last block assigned to this window. Purpose: The schedule determines who can produce the subsequent window.
H11: Last block complete. When: The leader completes the last block in its window. Action: End production for this window. Reason: The leader schedule assigns the next window separately.

a.xlink:title: The leader schedule assigns the next window separately.
H11: Last block complete
